title: confiture migrate rebuild --format json
description: Result of dropping the schemas, building from DDL and marking every migration applied (MigrateRebuildResult.to_dict). A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

schemas_dropped.description: Schemas dropped before the build; empty in --dry-run.

marked.description: Migrations marked as applied after the build.

seeds_applied.description: Seed files applied with --seed; null when seeds were not requested.

verified.description: The post-rebuild verification with --verify; null when it was not requested or in --dry-run.

total_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time of the operation, in milliseconds.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warning messages; empty if none.

error.description: Always null in this shape: a command that fails writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
